item_reviews.comment: T1 r7 shows 64.25% length and 97.00% relative accuracy on GSM8K; the mixed framing is accurate.
T1 r7 shows 76.30% length and 102.56% relative accuracy on MATH500, matching the item.
r7 has the lowest Rel. Len on both datasets (GSM8K 64.25 vs 67.15 for r8 and 67.60 for r3; MATH 76.30).
r7 is shorter than r8 on both datasets. Its accuracy is lower on GSM8K (97.00 vs 97.44) and higher on MATH (102.56 vs 101.58).
T2 values are quoted correctly. Out-of-domain lengths (88–90%) are well above in-domain lengths (64–76%), so the effect weakened but persisted.
The package states that no significance tests were reported, so the small average differences cannot be called established.
P1 supports it, but it is a measurement definition rather than a result a Results passage needs.

missing_core_findings.description: Fine-tuning on external GPT-4o CoT shortened reasoning on GSM8K (67.60% relative length), nearly as much as Method M. It cut MATH relative accuracy to 90.52% with a large SD (15.07). Self-generated approaches kept MATH accuracy at about 102%, so the source of the training data matters.
